paypal.desk.lede: Each PayLink invoice can have a PayPal twin. The desk reads both rails, proposes the next step, and acts *only when you approve the exact values*.
paypal.desk.head: Desk
paypal.desk.noApi: The desk needs this edition's API, and none is configured here. Invoices still work: your clients pay them in dollars on Ethereum Sepolia.
paypal.desk.connect: Connect the wallet you sign your invoices with to open your desk.
paypal.desk.sweeping: Reading every open invoice again on PayPal and on the chain…
paypal.desk.noProposals: Nothing to approve. Every invoice agrees on both rails.
paypal.notes.title: Test money only
paypal.notes.sandbox: PayPal sandbox and Ethereum Sepolia only. No real money.
paypal.notes.fence: The desk proposes only what the rules allow for each invoice, with the exact values. Nothing is sent, cancelled or recorded until you tap.
paypal.notes.truth: Paid is read from PayPal's own records or from the chain, never from a message or the assistant.
paypal.session.why: Your wallet signs a desk session: no transaction, no fee, valid 12 hours. It proves to PayLink's API that these invoices are yours.
paypal.session.signing: Sign the desk session in your wallet: no transaction, no fee, valid 12 hours.
paypal.exact.title: Exact values you approve
paypal.effect.reminder: PayPal emails your client its standard reminder
paypal.effect.share: You share the message yourself; nothing is sent by PayLink
paypal.effect.closeToken: The link stops accepting dollars on the chain
paypal.effect.closePaypal: PayPal stops accepting payment for this invoice
paypal.effect.record: PayPal's books show the invoice paid outside PayPal
paypal.approve.unconfirmed: PayPal did not answer. It may have sent the reminder, so PayLink counts it as sent and offers no other for 24 hours.
paypal.approving: Checking PayPal and the chain again before acting…
paypal.approved: Done. PayPal and the chain were read again first.
paypal.reminder.standard: PayPal sends its own standard wording: custom text cannot go through PayPal's reminder.
paypal.reminder.noEmail: PayPal's own reminder is not offered for this invoice: it has no client email on PayPal, and PayPal refuses to send a reminder without one.
paypal.cancel.signing: Approved. Now cancel the link in your wallet: one transaction, its Sepolia gas paid by you.
paypal.cancel.notHere: This invoice was not created on this device: cancel it from the device that signed it.
paypal.cancel.done: The link is cancelled on the chain. The desk closes this at its next check.
paypal.cancel.waiting: Waiting for the link's cancellation on the chain.
paypal.share.ready: Approved. Share the message with your client.
paypal.share.reminder: Hello, a friendly reminder about invoice {number} for {amount}. Thank you!
paypal.share.reminderLink: Hello, a friendly reminder about invoice {number} for {amount}. You can pay here: {url} Thank you!
paypal.assistant.grounded: Every number in this text matches your records.
paypal.assistant.template: The assistant's text did not match your records, so PayLink's standard sentence replaced it.
paypal.assistant.restingNote: The assistant has used today's allowance. The desk lists PayLink's own proposals, in fixed words.
paypal.assistant.offNote: The desk lists PayLink's own proposals, in fixed words.
paypal.reason.handsOff: Hands off: the two rails do not agree, so nothing is proposed.
paypal.reason.reminderDue: Due today or overdue, and unpaid on both rails.
paypal.reason.reminder3Days: Unpaid on both rails three days after it was sent.
paypal.reason.shareReminder: A reminder in your client's language, for you to send.
paypal.reason.paidOnPaypal: Paid on PayPal. Close the dollar option so your client cannot pay twice.
paypal.reason.markedPaid: You marked it paid on PayPal. Close the dollar option so it cannot be paid twice.
paypal.reason.paidOnChain: Paid in dollars on the chain. Record it on PayPal so both books agree.
paypal.reason.stillOpen: Recorded on PayPal, but PayPal's page still accepts payment. Cancel it there.
paypal.reason.undone: The record on PayPal was undone.
paypal.reason.recordMissing: The record on PayPal is gone, but the chain is paid.
paypal.reason.inFlight: A PayPal payment is in progress. Wait for it.
paypal.reason.confirming: A payment on the chain is being confirmed.
paypal.reason.paypalCancelled: Cancelled on PayPal. Close the dollar option too.
paypal.reason.chainCancelled: Cancelled on the chain. Cancel the PayPal invoice too.
paypal.reason.chainExpired: The link expired. Cancel the PayPal invoice too.
paypal.reason.other: A step PayLink's rules allow for this invoice.
paypal.alert.paidTwice: This invoice was paid on PayPal and on the chain.
paypal.alert.recordMissing: PayLink's record of the chain payment is no longer on the PayPal invoice, which can be paid again. Record it again, or cancel the PayPal invoice.
paypal.alert.guide1: Return the dollar payment to your client yourself, from your wallet:
paypal.alert.guide2: Or refund the PayPal payment in your PayPal dashboard (sandbox).
paypal.alert.guide3: PayLink does neither for you, and nothing here is automatic.
paypal.alert.handsOffNote: The desk proposes nothing for this invoice until both rails read consistently again.
paypal.alert.paypalUnreadable: PayPal could not be read for this invoice.
paypal.alert.chainUnreadable: The chain could not be read for this invoice.
paypal.alert.notDeployed: PayLink is not deployed on Ethereum Sepolia yet, so the chain has nothing to say.
paypal.alert.reference: The PayPal invoice's reference is not this link's key.
paypal.alert.currency: The PayPal invoice is not in US dollars.
paypal.alert.amount: The PayPal invoice's amount differs from the signed amount.
paypal.alert.paidAmount: PayPal records a payment of another amount.
paypal.alert.statusUnknown: PayPal reports a status PayLink does not know.
paypal.alert.scheduled: PayPal scheduled the invoice instead of sharing it.
paypal.alert.draft: PayPal shows the invoice as a draft after it was sent.
paypal.alert.noTransactions: PayPal says paid but lists no payment.
paypal.alert.openWithPayments: PayPal shows the invoice open with payments on it.
paypal.alert.unverified: A chain payment could not be verified.
paypal.alert.chainMismatch: The chain payment does not match the signed invoice.
paypal.alert.other: The rails disagree for this invoice.
paypal.record.title: Recorded on PayPal invoice {number}
paypal.record.note: The chain payment was verified at the exact amount, then recorded on PayPal by PayLink's rules, not by the assistant.
paypal.record.undoneNote: The record was undone: PayPal shows the invoice as before.
paypal.record.closedNote: Undo is no longer possible here after 24 hours: use your PayPal dashboard.
paypal.check.head: Was I really paid?
paypal.check.hint: Paste a payment notice, an email or a message. PayLink checks your invoices on PayPal and on the chain; the message itself is never taken as proof.
paypal.check.label: The message
paypal.check.empty: Paste the message to check first.
paypal.check.cannot: Can't check now. Nothing is concluded from the message.
paypal.check.receivedText: Your records show this payment as received.
paypal.check.notReceivedText: Neither PayPal nor the chain shows this payment. Whatever the message says, nothing has arrived.
paypal.check.partlyText: Only part of the amount shows as received.
paypal.check.unavailableText: A source did not answer, so there is no verdict. Try again in a moment.
paypal.ai.keyHint: Paste your client's message: the assistant drafts the invoice, you check it and sign.
paypal.ai.sheetLede: Paste the client's message or describe the job. The assistant only drafts: you check every value in the form, and only your signature makes the invoice.
paypal.ai.label: Client's message
paypal.ai.placeholder: Love it! Send me the invoice, $120, I'll pay by Friday.
paypal.ai.privacy: Drafting sends this text to PayLink's API and to Cloudflare Workers AI. Don't paste passwords or card numbers.
paypal.ai.empty: Paste a message or describe the job first.
paypal.ai.q.amountMissing: How much is it? The message names no amount.
paypal.ai.q.amountAmbiguous: Which amount? The message is not clear about it.
paypal.ai.q.severalAmounts: The message names several amounts: which one is the invoice?
paypal.ai.q.currency: The amount is not in US dollars. PayLink invoices in dollars and converts nothing.
paypal.ai.q.dueUnclear: When is it due? The date is not clear.
paypal.ai.q.duePast: The due date it names is in the past.
paypal.ai.q.dueFar: The due date it names is more than a year away.
paypal.ai.q.payeeIgnored: The message names an address to pay: it was ignored. You are always the payee.
paypal.ai.q.other: Check this draft against the message before you use it.
paypal.ai.checkNote: Check every value: the form is yours to edit before you sign.
paypal.ai.lowConfidence: The assistant is unsure about this draft. Check every value against the message.
paypal.ai.restingText: Today's allowance is used up. Write the invoice yourself: everything else works.
paypal.ai.unavailableText: Write it yourself: the form works as always.
paypal.ai.filled: Filled from the AI draft. Check every value, then review and sign.
paypal.ai.filledNoAmount: Filled from the AI draft, without an amount: enter it, check every value, then review and sign.
paypal.twin.head: PayPal twin
paypal.twin.lede: Let your client pay this invoice on PayPal's page too. PayLink makes one PayPal sandbox invoice for the same amount, with this link's key as its reference, then reads it back from PayPal.
paypal.twin.name: Client's name
paypal.twin.emailHint: Only for PayPal: it lets PayPal send its reminders. Never sent to the assistant.
paypal.twin.emailInvalid: This email address does not look right.
paypal.twin.creating: Making the twin on PayPal, then reading it back…
paypal.twin.created: PayPal twin {number} made and read back from PayPal.
paypal.twin.createdNote: The pay page now offers PayPal next to dollars on the chain. One link, two rails.
paypal.twin.unavailable: PayPal did not answer. Your invoice is valid and payable in dollars now; the PayPal option appears when PayPal answers.
paypal.twin.handsOff: PayPal's copy does not match this invoice, so the pay page will not offer PayPal. The desk shows why.
paypal.twin.noApi: PayPal twins need this edition's API, and none is configured here. The link works without it.
paypal.twin.ineligible.chain: PayPal twins are made for invoices on Ethereum Sepolia only.
paypal.twin.ineligible.open: An open-amount link cannot have a PayPal twin: PayPal invoices a fixed amount.
paypal.twin.ineligible.several: A link for several payments cannot have a PayPal twin: a PayPal invoice is paid once.
paypal.twin.ineligible.cents: This amount has a fraction of a cent, which PayPal cannot invoice.
paypal.twin.ineligible.token: PayPal twins are made for USDC and PayPal USD invoices only.
paypal.rails.head: Two ways to pay
paypal.rails.paypalNote: On PayPal's page · sandbox · {amount} checked against the signed invoice {time}
paypal.rails.withheld: The PayPal page offered for this link does not match it, so it is not shown. Pay in dollars below, or ask the sender.
paypal.rails.pendingHead: A PayPal payment is in progress.
paypal.rails.pending: PayPal shows a payment for this invoice that has not completed. Wait for it before paying any other way.
paypal.rails.paidHead: PayPal says this invoice is paid.
paypal.rails.paid: PayPal read {time}. If you paid it on PayPal, do not pay again.
paypal.rails.paidConfirm: I did not pay this invoice on PayPal: let me pay in dollars.
paypal.rails.paused: No {symbol} payment can go through while the issuer keeps it paused.
paypal.rails.frozen: The token's issuer has frozen an address this {symbol} payment needs, so it would fail.
paypal.status.assistantOff: Off: every feature works without it
paypal.status.model: Cloudflare Workers AI · {model} · {budget} neurons a day
paypal.status.modelLeft: Cloudflare Workers AI · {model} · {left} of {budget} neurons left today
paypal.status.resting: Resting until 00:00 UTC: today's {budget} neurons are spent. Every manual path works.
paypal.status.notDeployed: PayLinkV2 not deployed on Ethereum Sepolia yet
paypal.error.network: PayLink's API did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
paypal.error.invalid: PayLink's API answered something unexpected. Nothing was done.
paypal.error.session: Your desk session ended. Sign in again.
paypal.error.forbidden: This session may not do that.
paypal.error.origin: This page's address may not use PayLink's API.
paypal.error.notFound: Not found: it may have been closed already.
paypal.error.stale: The situation changed since this was proposed. Read the desk again.
paypal.error.conflict: This conflicts with the invoice's current state.
paypal.error.undoExpired: Undo is no longer possible here after 24 hours: use your PayPal dashboard.
paypal.error.busy: The invoice is being checked. Try again in a moment.
paypal.error.scheduled: PayPal scheduled the invoice instead of sharing it now.
paypal.error.dueDate: The due date is in the past.
paypal.error.clock: Your device's clock is off. Set it right, then try again.
paypal.error.rate: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then try again.
paypal.error.quota: Today's allowance for this demo is used up. Try again tomorrow.
paypal.error.paypalDown: PayPal did not answer. Try again in a minute.
paypal.error.chainDown: The chain could not be read. Try again in a moment.
paypal.error.notYet: Not available on this server yet.
paypal.error.internal: PayLink's API failed. Nothing was done.
paypal.till.received: Received {amount} USD on PayPal, as PayPal's own record says.
paypal.till.notWatched: PayPal is not watched on this device yet: open your desk session (one signature, no fee) and the till lights for a PayPal payment too. The chain is watched either way.
paypal.till.payeeOnly: Only the invoice's payee can watch its PayPal twin: connect the wallet that signed it.
paypal.till.ready: PayPal is watched once the till starts. It lights only when PayPal's own record says paid, at this exact amount.
paypal.till.watching: Watching PayPal too. The till lights only when PayPal's own record says paid, at this exact amount.
paypal.till.noTwin: This invoice has no PayPal twin: the till watches the chain.
paypal.till.unreachable: PayPal can't be read right now; trying again. The chain is still watched.
paypal.till.noApi: PayPal is not watched: this edition's API is not configured here. The chain is watched.
paypal.banner.sandbox: PayPal sandbox and testnets only. No real money.
paypal.copy.createH1b: Paid on PayPal or in dollars on chain
paypal.copy.createLede: Sign a dollar invoice in your wallet and make its PayPal twin. Your client pays on PayPal, or in USDC on chain from a wallet: *the first payment closes the other side*. Signing costs nothing: no gas, no sign-up.
paypal.copy.createStep3: Your client pays on PayPal, or from their wallet in USDC. PayLink reads both: a chain payment is recorded on PayPal for you, and a PayPal payment closes the link at your tap.
paypal.copy.payBillLede: Compare the amount and the address with what the seller told you. Pay on PayPal, or approve a payment from your wallet: the digital dollars then go *straight from your wallet to theirs*. PayLink never holds them.
paypal.copy.payStep2: Pay on PayPal's own page, or approve the payment in your wallet, which pays the small Sepolia network fee too.
paypal.copy.ticketScanSub: Pay on PayPal, or in {symbol} from any wallet. The first payment closes the invoice.
paypal.copy.tillLede: Keep this screen facing your counter. When the payment lands, the light turns green and the till chimes: *checked on PayPal or on the network*, not on the customer's phone.
paypal.copy.statusLede: Where PayLink v2 is deployed, whether each contract is the genuine release, and whether PayPal, the network and the API answer. The network is read live; *the PayPal rows are the API's latest reads*.
paypal.copy.ledgerLede: Every invoice this wallet signed on this device, *checked against the network*, with what PayPal last said of its twin. Copy a link to send it again, or cancel it so it can no longer be paid.
paypal.rails.tokenKey: Or pay in {symbol} from a wallet
paypal.alert.recordMissingNote: Its proposals are below: record the chain payment on PayPal again, or cancel the PayPal invoice.
